sportsdataverse.providers.espn_fantasy — 16 endpoints. Note: Public data only. No cookie is ever sent, so these wrappers read every game's league-agnostic routes and the PUBLIC leagues ESPN lists in espn_fantasy_league_directory. A private league answers HTTP 401: reading one needs its owner's espn_s2 / SWID cookies, which this package does not take. Note: Season ids are ESPN's: the start year for football (2026 = fall 2026), the end year for basketball and hockey (2026-27 = 2027). Ids are Int64; team_id is unique only inside one league. No member or owner account id is returned.
